provenance: Project-authored public synthetic examples; no user text, contacts, private dictionary or external evaluation dataset.
authoring: Core regression pairs are literal. Other wrong-layout inputs were authored with a separate transcribed standard QWERTY/ЙЦУКЕН fixture, never the production KeyMapping. All expected spellings were independently selected; the shipped JSON is static.
limits: Small editorial regression corpus, not a representative precision estimate. Rare subtitle spellings and intent can be ambiguous. No model training, personal learning, or live input is involved.
